# contact point provider

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:contactPointProvider`](gmeow-contactPointProvider.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/contactPointProvider>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/contacts`](../../slices/contacts.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The agent (typically an organization) that issues or scopes a contact point — the employer behind a work address, the provider behind an email's domain. Range is [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) to avoid a contacts→organization dependency while admitting organizations. Non-functional. The context that distinguishes 'my work email at ACME' from a personal one.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:ContactPoint`](../classes/gmeow-ContactPoint.md) -> [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:contactPointProvider`](gmeow-contactPointProvider.md) from [`gmeow:ContactPoint`](../classes/gmeow-ContactPoint.md) to [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:ContactPoint`](../classes/gmeow-ContactPoint.md), [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to name the organization (or agent) that issues or scopes a contact point — the context that distinguishes a work channel from a personal one.

### Avoid when

- Avoid using it for the contact point's usage role (that is [`gmeow:contactPointType`](gmeow-contactPointType.md)) and avoid forcing a single provider (it is non-functional).

### How to use

- Link the contact point to the providing [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md); the range is left broad to admit organizations without a contacts→organization slice dependency.

### Examples

- ex:lillithWorkEmail [`gmeow:contactPointProvider`](gmeow-contactPointProvider.md) ex:acmeCorp.
